name: cpn-ide-vscode
description: Edit, validate and simulate Coloured Petri Nets (CPN Tools .cpn models or plain-text .petri.json) with the bundled CPN IDE editor and simulator.

commands.title: CPN IDE: Open in CPN IDE
CPN IDE: Convert to Text Model
CPN IDE: Reopen as XML Text

cpnIde.backendUrl.markdownDescription: URL of an external CPN IDE backend (for example the Docker image `ghcr.io/alefire99/cpn-ide-backend`). Leave empty to use the bundled local backend.

cpnIde.javaPath.markdownDescription: Path to a Java 17+ executable. Leave empty to use `JAVA_HOME`, `java` on the PATH, or an automatically downloaded runtime.

cpnIde.port.markdownDescription: Port for the local backend. `0` picks a free port automatically.

cpnIde.simulation.stepDelayMs.markdownDescription: Delay in milliseconds between steps of a multi-step simulation in the CPN IDE UI (upstream: 500). Applies when an editor is (re)opened.

cpnIde.simulation.animate.markdownDescription: Animate token movement during simulation in the CPN IDE UI. Turn off for faster simulation. Applies when an editor is (re)opened.

cpnIde.debug.markdownDescription: Keep the CPN IDE UI's verbose `console.log` output (full request/response payloads) in the webview developer tools.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with CPN IDE
walkthroughs.description: Open, simulate and write Coloured Petri Nets in VS Code.

steps.title: Open an example
steps.description:
Copy one of the bundled example models into your workspace and open it in the CPN IDE canvas. The first time, the backend starts (and Java 17 is downloaded if none is found); the project console then reports **Model is correct**.
[Open an Example](command:cpnIde.openExample)

media.altText: An example net open in the CPN IDE canvas

steps.title: Simulate it
steps.description:
Click **Start simulation** in the CPN IDE toolbar. Enabled transitions turn green: click one to fire it, or use **Multi-Step** in the Simulation panel. Markings are shown next to each place.
For a quick check without the UI, simulate the open model for N steps and read the final marking:
[Run Without the UI](command:cpnIde.runSimulation)

media.altText: A simulation in progress, with enabled transitions highlighted

steps.title: Write your own net
steps.description:
A net can be plain text: NAME.petri.json for places, transitions and arcs, NAME.sml for colour sets and variables. Edit the JSON (with completion from the schema) and the canvas follows; errors appear in the Problems panel.
[Create a Net](command:cpnIde.newNet)

media.altText: A text model next to its diagram

steps.title: Linux: install 32-bit glibc
steps.description:
The CPN simulator needs the 32-bit C library. Install it once, then reopen your model.
[Show Backend Log](command:cpnIde.showLog)

steps.title: macOS: use the Docker backend
steps.description:
The simulator cannot run on macOS. Start the backend in Docker and point the extension at it.
[Set the Backend URL](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22cpnIde.backendUrl%22%5D)

steps.title: Tune the settings
steps.description:
Make multi-step runs faster, turn off the token animation, or choose which Java and backend to use.
[Open CPN IDE Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22cpnIde%22%5D)
